caption: The drawing depicts a tall, ornate cup or goblet, rendered in pencil or graphite on a beige background. The cup has an outwardly flaring rim and a slightly tapered, cylindrical body with a circular base, all shaded to indicate metallic material. The upper band of the cup showcases a decorative floral or vegetal motif. The central section of the cup features a large, oval-shaped medallion bordered by intricate scrollwork and two stylized creatures that appear to be dragons or griffins, facing outward. Within this oval, there is a detailed figure of a robed individual holding a cross. Above the medallion, at the rim of the cup, there is a decorative element resembling a horned mask or face. On either side of the main cup are enlarged, detailed views of two additional oval medallions, each surrounded by ornate, symmetrical flourishes and topped with an eagle or bird motif; the left medallion contains a figure in robes holding a staff and a book, while the right medallion depicts a robed figure with a cross and book. At the bottom right corner of the drawing is a simple line sketch showing the profile or outline shape of the cup. The entire composition is monochromatic, using shades of grey and subtle differences in shading for depth and texture. At the top, there is a handwritten label or identifier in a rectangular frame.
title: Silver Beakers
